The introspect decision headers use only gh/ paths, so none of these strings depends on the file existing.

summary: The change does what the reading asked. It moves crates/athena-core/src/run.rs to run/mod.rs, and git sees this as a rename (99% similar, 2 lines added and 2 removed). The only edited lines are the two test include_str! paths for athena.toml and defaults.toml, which each gain one `../`. A CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] → Changed records the move. lib.rs is unchanged, `pub mod run;` still resolves to the same module path, and run/ holds only mod.rs. On the candidate, the 7 run:: tests list under the same names and all pass. I did not build the parent commit, because that would mean changing git state. Instead, the diff shows that no test attribute, test name or module declaration changed, so the test names before and after are the same by construction. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed (1397 tests), and no #[allow] was added. One small note: run_pin_tests.rs is listed as a deliverable to modify but was correctly left alone. It is declared in lib.rs as its own crate-level module, not inside run.rs, so its `../../../` include_str! paths still resolve.
